heading: Court Blocks Immigration Conditions on Public Safety Grants
summary: Wisconsin DOJ said a federal judge permanently blocked the administration from imposing immigration enforcement conditions on certain public safety grants. Wisconsin joined the multistate challenge. The agency said the conditions threatened more than $6 million in Wisconsin funding.

heading: Health Officials Report Possible Measles Exposure in Weston
summary: State and Marathon County health officials reported a possible measles exposure at the Marshfield Medical Center–Weston emergency department. They identified November 5 from 1:30 to 3:30 p.m. as the exposure window. The health departments said they were working to notify people who may have been exposed.
